original.target_description: Study 1: camp-size main effect on preference ratings, 2 × 2 within-subjects ANOVA; small versus large Rwanda camp, averaging domestic comparison programs.

n.sample_role: participants in target analysis; analytic n unestablished
n.exclusions: 54 volunteers are reported, but target F(1,52) is inconsistent with that total; no analytic n explicitly established. No participant exclusion explanation found.

replication.target_description: Study 1a: post-exclusion camp-size comparison across both refugee locations and domestic comparison programs; paired t-test, larger versus smaller camp.
